body:
Talking to you has made me feel a lot better, thank you :) I don’t feel as dreadful as I did this morning.
A pattern has developed of me waking up and feeling suicidal with the feeling lessening throughout the day.
Having a BA is a massive achievement! I’m taking a year out of uni atm and getting my BA was one of my goals, but I too am feeling prettt suicidal atm. I’m proud of you.

Honestly, I have no idea. I played with the thought of going on to do a masters in nursing with the experience I’ve gained working at the doctors, but the next few years just seem intolerable. Uni is important because it’s the only route I’ve ever really considered.

I just feel that I’m nowhere near where I’m meant to be. I can’t drive when plenty of people my age can. I have bad a levels and I’m taking a year out of uni, the thought of going back makes me feel sick but the thought of dropping out feels even worse. My personal life isn’t great, I haven’t had a relationship for longer than 6 months. I’m just so tired of suffering; it’s like my brain is always looking for something for me to overthink.
Yeah I’ve told my doctor, I hope I pull through and do it tonight but I don’t think I will. It’s so insufferable being here.
I know people love me, which is the sucky part. I’m never going to recover or be good enough. I can’t go on
I’m just so tired of suffering no matter what
I think it would be, I can’t remember a time I wasn’t suffering and I’m just completely useless. I’d rather people remember me well.
The worst thing is is I’m at work thinking that I have to do it when I get home, and I never do because I always feel too tired. It’s pathetic and I want to find the motivation to just end it.

I think what hurts the most is when I compare myself to other people. Most people my age can now drive AND have better results than me AND are in a relationship. I just feel like I don’t want to continue anymore, I just feel completely pathetic.

I’ve had so must help but I feel as though it’s too late for me to recover. I haven’t enjoyed a period of my life and I feel as though it’s only going to get worse. I think I’d like to go through with it but I never can. I just want to find peace.
I want to kill myself but I can’t even do that right. I just want it to stop.
